The '''Place of Sickness''' was a dwelling located in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was where the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|medicine man]] would use medicinal plants and magic wands of healing to cure [[Disease/Legends|sicknesses]].
